description: List a user's repos with sort/direction/type — opaque Link cursor (~0.4/repo). Costs ~12 credits (0.4/result). Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous nextCursor (GitHub Link page=). Not a bare page number.

direction.description: asc or desc (default desc). Echoed as data.direction.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 30, max 100). Billed per result.

sort.description: created | updated | pushed | full_name (default updated). Not stars — GitHub's user-repos API has no stars sort. Echoed as data.sort.

type.description: owner (default) | member | all — affiliation filter. Echoed as data.type.

username.description: GitHub username or profile URL, e.g. torvalds.

name: github_repositories
title: GitHub Repositories
